description: Verzorgingsplaats gevoeligheid hittestress is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. Map shows the feeling temperature (in degrees Celsius) at care places during a tropical day (33.1 degrees in the Bilt). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Care site sensitivity heat stress" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://downloads.rijkswaterstaatdata.nl/pdf-documenten/Geogedeeld-licentie-rijkswaterstaat.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
